name: Agentic Ai Action Level Accountability
text: Agentic AI governance should be organized around action level accountability. A governance roadmap is incomplete unless it can reconstruct the agent action, delegated mandate, evidence used, review path, and downstream effect.
scope_conditions: Agentic AI systems with delegated authority where actions, evidence, review, and downstream effects can be recorded.

name: Mcp Governance Auditable Continuous Process

name: Dao Governance Power Allocation Execution Exposure
text: DAO governance must be assessed at the level of power allocation and execution exposure, not only procedural form. A voting process does not establish decentralization when purchasable influence, delegation concentration, or automatic execution leave governance open to capture.
scope_conditions: DAO governance systems where influence can be purchased or concentrated through delegation, or where formally valid votes can trigger automatic execution.

name: Dao Governance Explicit Capture Resistance
text: DAO governance should be evaluated by explicit resistance to capture, participation collapse, and collective-action failure. Token voting is an input, not evidence that those failure modes have been solved.
scope_conditions: DAO governance systems using token voting or comparable on-chain collective decision procedures.

name: Machine Agency Action Level Attribution
text: Machine agency governance must preserve action-level attribution across delegation chains. Architecture diagrams and policy statements are insufficient if a reviewer cannot reconstruct which agent acted, under whose authority, using which evidence, and with which downstream effect.
scope_conditions: Multi-agent or autonomous systems with delegated authority and distributed actions.

name: Decentralized Ai Incentive Compatibility
text: Decentralized AI architecture should evaluate incentive compatibility separately from technical distribution. A system is not institutionally decentralized merely because agents, wallets, and execution are distributed.
scope_conditions: Decentralized AI and DAO architectures using tokens, distributed execution, or agent coordination.

name: Agentic Payments Bounded Mandates
text: Agentic payment design must couple programmable settlement with bounded mandates, transaction-level provenance, revocation, and accountable loss allocation. Efficient settlement without institutional controls scales the consequences of error.
scope_conditions: Autonomous agent payments using programmable or stablecoin settlement where agents may act without transaction-by-transaction human authorization.

name: Agentic Commerce Portable Performance Layer
text: Agentic commerce protocols need a portable, verifiable performance layer that records completed transactions, disputes, reversals, and validated outcomes without collapsing reputation into a single platform score.
scope_conditions: Repeated agentic commerce where counterparties need portable performance evidence and transaction-level recourse.
